subject: Which moments count: audit window inclusivity & evidence timing
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@big4audit.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Cho <emily.cho@acme-health.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Clarify inclusivity of audit window and evidence timing

Hi Logan,

Quick question as we begin the evidence pull for Acme Health: your SOC 2 Type II report we have on file lists an audit period but the requester is asking for clarity on two points that matter for sampling and bridge letter language:

1) Are the first and last calendar days of the audit period inclusive (i.e., does Oct 1, 2025 count as covered for day-of-month evidence and does Sep 30, 2026 count)?
2) For point-in-time evidence (user config snapshots, ACL exports, system configuration), do you take snapshots at 00:00 UTC, end-of-day UTC, or based on Pacific local time? The team needs this so they can pick correct log slices.

If the period does not include the most recent month(s), we'll need a bridge letter that states coverage and any known exceptions. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a bridge letter and (tentatively) basic samples of the following: a) auth/logins for a 48-hour window at month-end, b) an ACL/configuration export for a single point-in-time, and c) your backup retention policy page?

Target deadline for the pull is 2026-11-03 to stay on our timeline for the SOC evidence review — can you let me know if that works?

Thanks,
Oliver
Oliver Grant
Senior IT Audit Manager
Big4 Audit LLP

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@big4audit.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify inclusivity of audit window and evidence timing

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) Audit period inclusivity: our SOC 2 Type II report covers Oct 1, 2025 through Sep 30, 2026 inclusive — both endpoints are considered in-scope for evidence.

2) Snapshot timing for point-in-time artifacts: we standardize on end-of-day UTC (23:59:59 UTC) for system snapshots and configuration exports used in audits. Operational logs are stored with UTC timestamps.

Bridge letter: yes, we can provide a bridge letter that states the covered dates and notes that operational snapshots are end-of-day UTC. I will loop in Marissa in Security to draft the letter and Neha to assemble the log samples and ACL export.

Attachments we plan to provide: the SOC 2 PDF, a bridge letter draft, and a zipped sample of audit logs (sanitized). I can post these to a shared Drive link by Friday. If you need them sooner, let us know and we'll expedite.

CC'd Marissa & Neha to confirm timing and attachments.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0162

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@big4audit.com>, Emily Cho <emily.cho@acme-health.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify inclusivity of audit window and evidence timing — evidence package

On Thu, Oct 28, 2026 at 11:02 AM Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com> wrote:
> 1) Audit period inclusivity: our SOC 2 Type II report covers Oct 1, 2025 through Sep 30, 2026 inclusive — both endpoints are considered in-scope for evidence.
> 2) Snapshot timing for point-in-time artifacts: we standardize on end-of-day UTC (23:59:59 UTC) for system snapshots and configuration exports used in audits.

Thanks Logan — jumping in with the technical artifacts. Attached are the sanitized stubs for the examples Oliver requested:

- ACME_SoC2_TypeII_2025-10-01_to_2026-09-30.pdf (official report) [attachment stub]
- bridge_letter_20261001.pdf (draft bridge letter; confirms coverage and snapshot convention) [attachment stub]
- audit_log_samples_20261030.zip (contains auth.log slice and index; logs are redacted for PII) [attachment stub]

Notes on the artifacts:
- The ACL/config export we use for audits is generated as an end-of-day UTC snapshot (timestamped 2026-09-30T23:59:59Z in the export).
- Our logging system timestamps events in UTC; the sample contains log lines spanning 2026-09-29T23:00:00Z through 2026-10-01T01:00:00Z to show month-end rollover.
- Backup/retention: our policy retains full system backups for 365 days; incremental logs are retained for 540 days. See the retention_policy.pdf link on the Drive.

Link to secure Drive folder (access granted to Big4 audit alias): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/sox/soc2/ACME-2026-evidence

If you need an alternate snapshot time (e.g., 00:00 local) for a specific test, tell us the exact timestamp and we can attempt to produce a targeted extract, but the canonical audit artifacts are end-of-day UTC.

Neha Kapoor
Sr. Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@big4audit.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Cho <emily.cho@acme-health.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify inclusivity of audit window and evidence timing — evidence package

Thanks Neha & Logan — this is perfect and exactly what we needed.

A few confirmations for the audit file notes:
- We will treat Oct 1, 2025 and Sep 30, 2026 as in-scope (inclusive) for all sampling.
- End-of-day UTC snapshot convention is acceptable and we'll reflect that in our working papers.
- The bridge letter draft looks fine — we'll accept the final signed version once you have it back from your legal/security sign-off.

Emily from Acme: if you want the files uploaded to your internal evidence repo, we can either share from this Drive link or Acme can pull and ingest; let us know preference.

Appreciate the quick turnaround. We're on track for the Nov 3 evidence review; if anything changes we'll reach out.

Regards,
Oliver
